title: R4 preview wiring (U-key -> update_preview -> preview card) has zero automated test coverage
evidence:
capture_frame :: proc(rc: ^Render_Ctx, topo: ^pp.Topology, bundles: ^pp.Bundles, flow: ^pp.Flow_State, crisis: ^pp.Crisis_State, tick: u64, era: u8) -> rl.Image {
	rl.BeginDrawing()
	rnd.draw_world(&rc.view, topo, bundles, flow, crisis, tick, {})
	rnd.draw_forecast_panel(&rc.view, crisis, rc.view.catalogs, era)
---
      - name: Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)
        run: odin test core
detail: Acceptance 2's player-facing path — select pipe + U toggles preview, update_preview recomputes, draw_upgrade_preview renders — is exercised by nothing automated: no @(test) in app/, CI runs only `odin test core`, the demo language has no key verb, and the harness always passes a nil preview.
recommended_fix: Add a harness capture that renders a non-nil preview card (T2 golden), or extract update_preview's state decision into a pure proc with @(test) pins in core.

title: Preview-card rendering branches (overflow cap, zero-shift, magnet line, pluralization) untested
detail: The >12-bucket overflow tail, empty-shift "no reroute predicted" line, magnet aggregation, singular/plural conjugation, and the "?" fallback branch have no unit or golden coverage. These branches produce the exact text that could misinform players.
recommended_fix: Move Preview_Row aggregation plus preview_row_line/flow_word into pure procs with @(test) pins; capture golden frames of a dense preview card and an empty one.
